name: ATARAXIA ART
summary: Amazon marketplace filament brand best known for a 'patented' Flexible PLA+ claimed to stretch 5-6x further than standard PLA, alongside PLA+, silk, matte, high-speed and wood PLA and PETG. Company, location and manufacturer are unknown.

product_lines.name: Flexible PLA+
product_lines.notes: Marketed as 'patented' with 5-6x the stretch of PLA; still a PLA-based product, not TPU, so mapped to pla-plus.

additional_notes: Sold on Amazon (mirrored via desertcart); no brand website found. Vacuum sealed with desiccant and a 'lifetime satisfaction guarantee'; reviews cite moisture and winding problems. No relationships found. Price tier unverified.

provenance.conflicts: Only marketplace mirrors and aggregator listings; identity unresolved.
